title: Repeating Work with Loops and Ranges Check

questions.prompt: Which range produces 0, 1, and 2 but not 3?
questions.explanation: The ..< operator creates an open upper bound.

questions.prompt:
What is total after this loop?
var total = 0
for (n in 1..3) total += n
questions.explanation: The closed range visits 1, 2, and 3, which sum to 6.

questions.prompt: Complete the update so this loop terminates: var n = 0; while (n < 3) { ___ }
questions.explanation: The loop state must move toward making n < 3 false.
